### What You’re Called
Author: MaryBeth Whalen
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-oct-17-2007-11556955.html
Passage: Isaiah 56:5
Points:
- God grants an enduring name and purpose to His people rather than defining them by past labels.
- Scripture shows God looking past human weakness, seeing Gideon as a warrior and Simon as a rock.
- Real transformation and worth come through God's daily renewal rather than self-reliance.
- Believers are urged to let go of false self-perceptions and embrace what God calls them to do.
